sources.entry: Education CoPilot - AI tool helps teachers design their curriculum, lesson plans and activities, and track the progress of their students. #freemium

summary.name: Education Copilot
summary.one_liner: Education Copilot is an AI toolkit that generates standards-aligned lesson plans, worksheets, slides, rubrics, quizzes and unit plans for teachers.
use_cases: Generating a lesson plan with objectives and assessments
Creating worksheets and reading comprehension questions
Building a slide deck for a class topic
Writing grading rubrics aligned to learning objectives
Mapping a unit or semester syllabus with pacing
summary.what_it_does: Education Copilot generates lesson plans, worksheets, slides or PowerPoint decks, rubrics, quizzes and answer keys, and unit or syllabus plans based on a teacher's grade, subject and topic. The page says outputs are aligned to Common Core and state standards by default, and that teachers can adjust them. Tools also cover IEP and ELL differentiation and drafting parent newsletters and emails. Resources can be edited and exported to PDF, Word, Google Docs or slides.
notable: Standards-aligned output (Common Core and state standards) by default
Covers many teacher tools in one place: lesson plans, worksheets, slides, rubrics, quizzes, unit planning
Exports to PDF, Word, Google Docs and slides
caveats: Pro tier offers unlimited generations; the free plan is limited to core tools
Team, school and district plans exist, with pricing on a separate page not described here
Page advises not to enter students' personally identifiable information
